node.label: Methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus infection
node.definition: Infection with staphylococcus aureus resistant to the antibiotic methicillin (MRSA). MRSA can infect any individual but is more common among hospitalized patients, and can also occur as an opportunistic infection.

evidence.snippet: Immunodeficiency 124, severe combined: Methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus infection (frequency 1/1) [PCS]
